title: Noam Chomsky - Freedom of Speech for Views You Don't Like
summary: A ten-minute clip of Noam Chomsky on the Faurisson affair and free speech. He argues that supporting free speech means defending views you despise.
why: HN quotes it in censorship and moderation threads for Chomsky's principle that free speech must cover speech you dislike.

quote.text: If you're in favor of freedom of speech, that means you're in favor of speech precisely for views you despise
